==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Moiraine Damodred]]}}

[[File:Blue Ajah.jpg|thumb|300px|The Blue Ajah]]
[[Moiraine]] and [[Siuan]] enter the [[Blue Ajah]] quarters where all the sisters are waiting. [[Anaiya]] greets them first. [[Kairen Stang|Kairen]] is next, followed by thirty-nine others. Anaiya accompanies [[Cabriana]] to drop the newly raised Aes Sedai to their rooms, and confirms that [[Eadyth]] is the [[First Selector]]. The rooms are lavish: they each have a bedroom, dressing room, sitting room, and study. Everything is too frilly for Moiraine's liking, but Siuan likes it. Moiraine wears her ''[[kesiera]]'' for the first time in six years. They head back to Eadyth's quarters, where she tells them speaking of strength in the [[One Power]] is the second greatest rudeness, speaking of age being the first. Nevertheless, [[Aes Sedai]] are to always judge another's strength and defer respectively. Failure to defer is the third greatest rudeness. On the way back to their rooms, [[Cetalia]] interrupts them. She gives Siuan a puzzle to solve. When she does, the older Aes Sedai hustles Siuan off to her own rooms. Anaiya returns and offers Moiraine [[Healing]] to ease the tightness of the [[Three Oaths|Oaths]], although in reality it is to heal her last punishment as [[Accepted]] for the attempted mice prank on [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]]. She also brings a summons to see [[Tamra]].

:{{pov|[[Siuan Sanche]]}}

After hours of testing, Cetalia conscripts Siuan to be her assistant as eyes and ears for the Blue Ajah. Siuan is dismayed, but sadly has no choice. As Siuan leaves and finds Moiraine sitting disconsolately, she finds out that Tamra put Moiraine in charge of dispursing the bounty. Now neither of them will be able to leave the [[White Tower]] to search for the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Siuan tells a little bit too much to Moiraine, who immediately figures out she is helping head the eyes-and-ears of the Blue. Siuan tells Moiraine that dispursing the bounty would only take a few months and she would be able to leave the Tower afterwards, but Moiraine tells Siuan that the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] may have made her Queen of [[Cairhien]] by then. Siuan thinks Moiraine would make a great queen, but Moiraine tells her of the difficulty of being the monarch of Cairhien. The monarchy is under constant threat and must resort to unscrupulous tactics to maintain the throne. She does not want to be like her ruthless grandmother, [[Carewin Damodred]]. Siuan tells her friend not to despair over her perceived lack of agency. Moiraine offers Healing and Siuan kisses her with glee.

:{{pov|[[Lan Mandragoran]]}}

[[Lan]] and his men scout the [[Aiel]] as they cross [[Kinslayer's Dagger]] heading to the [[Spine of the World]]. Some of the men want to attack the retreating Aiel rather than just watch them, but [[Bukama Marenellin|Bukama]] knows they would have no chance against the Aiel fighting in mountains. Bukama is concerned that [[Pedron Niall]] may issue such a foolish order to attack, but Lan knows Niall is no fool. Lan itches to return to the [[Great Blight|Blight]] to resume his war with the [[Shadow]], but Bukama convinces him to wait at least another four months. As the Aiel withdraw into the [[Aiel Waste|Waste]], Lan and Bukama leave the other soldiers and head south, away from [[Tar Valon]]. Lan has no desire to be entangled with Aes Sedai.
